translations.web: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
translations.bsb: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
translations.asv: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.
